article.title: Appeal to National Company Law Appellate Tribunal.
article.content: Any information utility which is aggrieved by the order of the Board made under section 210 may prefer an appeal to the National Company Law Appellate Tribunal in such form, within such period, and in such manner, as may be specified by regulations.
article.html:
211Appeal to National Company Law Appellate Tribunal.

Section 211 · Part IV · Chapter V · page 135 of the Act

Any information utility which is aggrieved by the order of the Board made under section 210 may prefer an appeal to the National Company Law Appellate Tribunal in such form, within such period, and in such manner, as may be specified by regulations.
